sees: own retained negative and positive memory about the partner

calm.affiliate: aff_base + aff_extraversion*extraversion + aff_trust*trust + aff_affect*affect - aff_stress*stress + aff_closeness*closeness_pref

conflict.repair: rep_base + rep_agree*agreeableness + rep_forgive*forgiveness + rep_trust*trust + rep_posmem*pos_load - rep_negmem*neg_load + rep_partner_repaired*[partner repaired] - rep_intensity*intensity + rep_days*min(days,30)
conflict.escalate: esc_base + esc_neuro*neuroticism + esc_engage*conflict_engagement + esc_negmem*neg_load + esc_stress*stress - esc_trust*trust + esc_partner_escalated*[partner escalated] - esc_affect*affect
conflict.withdraw: wd_base + wd_avoidant*(1-conflict_engagement) + wd_neuro*neuroticism + wd_intensity*intensity + wd_partner_escalated*[partner escalated]
conflict.leave: leave_base - leave_commit*commitment - leave_trust*trust + leave_negmem*neg_load - leave_posmem*pos_load + leave_intensity*intensity + leave_days*min(days,30) - leave_satisfaction*satisfaction + leave_network*divorced_friend_share + leave_outside_option*outside_option + leave_dating_bonus*[dating]

separated.repair (reunite): sep_reunite_base + rep_agree*agreeableness + rep_forgive*forgiveness + rep_trust*trust + rep_posmem*pos_load - rep_negmem*neg_load + rep_partner_repaired*[partner repaired]
separated.leave (finalise): sep_leave_base + (conflict leave formula with min(days,60) and without leave_base)
